items.title: 17.11 RL series circuit se AC (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 17.11 with the boxes and self-checks (PDF 100-102).

blocks.text: Ek AC circuit lein jis mein resistor R aur inductor L series mein AC source V se jure hain (Fig. 17.10(a)). Series mein hone ki wajah se R aur L dono mein ek hi current I behta hai:

blocks.alt: (a) AC supply V (+ aur -) ke saath series mein resistor R aur inductor L; current I circuit mein ghoomta; double arrows R par VR aur L par VL. (b) Voltage V aur current I, omega t 0 se 360 degree, aik hi period; V current se theta aage. (c) Vector diagram OABP: OA = VR current I ki direction mein (R), OB = AP = VL (XL = wL) vertical, aur diagonal OP = V = IZ angle theta par.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.10: (a) AC supply se jura RL series circuit; (b) RL series circuit ki voltage aur current waves; (c) VR aur VL ka vector diagram (kitab ki Figure 17.10 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 17.10(b) mein voltage current se poora 90° aage aur alag frequency par bana hai, aur (c) mein OA ke neeche 'V' likha hai. Sahi: dono ki frequency ek hai, voltage sirf θ aage hai (tan θ = ωL/R), aur OA resistor ka voltage V_R hai; poora voltage V = IZ lakeer OP hai. Kitab ke (b) aur (c) ke captions mein 'waveform in of' aur 'VR and VL in of' likha hai; faltu 'in' oopar caption mein hata diya gaya hai.
R mein rms current I ho to R par rms voltage V_R:
Yeh voltage current ke saath in phase hai, is liye Fig. 17.10(c) mein ise current ki direction (simt) mein lakeer OA se dikhaya gaya hai. L par rms voltage V_L:

L par voltage, L ke current se 90° aage hai (Fig. 17.10(b)); vector diagram mein yeh lakeer OB hai. Kul voltage V in dono, V_R aur V_L, ka vector sum hai, jo lakeer OP hai (Fig. 17.10(c)). Dono 90° par hain, is liye Pythagoras se:

blocks.title: For your information (aap ki maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text: Electric eel (bijli wali machhli) apne 3 bare organs (aza) se strong (taqatwar) shock (jhatka) deti hai. Yeh organs eel ki length (lambai) ka taqreeban 80% hain aur khaas cells se bane hain jinhein electrocytes kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Electric eel: lambi gehre rang ki machhli jis ka pet halka hai, neele-hare paani mein ret wali tah ke oopar balkhati hui; munh baen taraf khula, aur jism ke gird safed bijli ki chingariyan.
blocks.caption: Aap ki maloomat ke liye: electric eel (kitab ke box ki tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab in cells ko 'electrolytes' likhti hai. Sahi naam electrocytes hai; electrolyte to woh solution (mehlool) hai jis mein se bijli guzarti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan (IᵣₘₛR²) + (IᵣₘₛX_L²) chhapti hai, yani square sirf R aur X_L par. Sahi (IᵣₘₛR)² + (IᵣₘₛX_L)² hai, jis se Iᵣₘₛ bahar aa kar Iᵣₘₛ√(R² + X_L²) banta hai.

blocks.text_alt: As X_L = ωL, so Vᵣₘₛ = Iᵣₘₛ √(R² + (ωL)²)

blocks.text: Z ki lakeer R ki lakeer se jo angle θ banati hai, wahi lagaye gaye voltage aur current ka phase difference hai. RL circuit mein voltage current se θ aage hota hai.
